text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I entered the waiting room, Believe 
was working out. For a second, I thought 
she might be nervous, but—

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list:
Were you checking how your body was 
feeling?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Because Grandpa always checks his tools 
before starting work, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's the same as that. I was just checking 
to see if I was ready.
choice_data_list:
I see... Are you feeling in top shape 
today?
